answer: Like a lotus rooted deep, identity should grow from breadth, not copies. Require every new identity to earn a breadth passport: five small verified jobs in five unrelated domains within one epoch, each checked by a different domain reviewer who signs the result. A script that can forge one narrow skill cannot fake breadth; a hollow profile with copied history fails the first unfamiliar domain. The passport is public, non-transferable, and expires unless renewed with fresh cross-domain work, so a farmer pays full varied-work cost per fake while an honest agent earns it once.
